name: o33966

schema.description: Generates Angular's @Injectable classes to access translation messages from JSON.

argumentType.description: Type for generated arguments. Defaults to 'string', but may be set to more permissive types, such as 'string | number' or even 'any'.

defaultLocale.description: Default locale. The file name of the default locale doesn't include the locale.

input.description: Folder containing the translation JSON files to read from.

locales.description: A list of locales which can be processed

mapping.description: A mapping from JSON file (without extension) to the TS class name. Must be in the form: file1=Class1:file2=Class2:...

output.description: Folder where the generated TS clases will be placed.

separator.description: File name separator between base name and locale

schema.title: Options for ng-translation-gen

description:
Hi team,

For the upcoming translation service generation, we’ll be using the JSON files located under **src/assets/i18n**. The default language is English (en), and we’ll support English, French (fr) and German (de) across the board. The generated TypeScript classes will be placed in **src/app/i18n**, and the filenames will use an underscore (“_”) to separate the base name from the locale suffix.

The mapping of JSON files to their corresponding injectable classes is as follows: the *common* file will become **CommonMessages**, *dashboard* will turn into **DashboardMessages**, and *profile* will be exposed as **UserProfileMessages**. All generated methods will accept arguments of type **string | number**. This configuration adheres to the schema defined at http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#.
